formatter_source.finding: Register<T> sets Check<T>.registered before assigning Cache<T>.formatter; the cache initializer can return early after observing that flag. A concurrent first generic root read/write can observe a null formatter. Existing generated ReadPackable/WritePackable dispatch bypasses this root formatter lookup.
formatter_source.deterministic_model: With parallel execution disabled for the collection, retain the valid formatter, register a null root formatter to model the published-flag/pending-assignment window, invoke the production client path against a generated-dispatch fake peer, and restore in finally. Both Global and PartitionedByKey paths are exercised. Root request/response, file mutation/result, Streams and DLQ fail before the fix.
